requirements.condition: An endpoint receives a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.
requirements.why_checkable: A state-machine test can deliver a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame and verify that the endpoint transitions to the draining state.

requirements.condition: The endpoint is in the draining state.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet output can be monitored after entry into the draining state to verify that no packets are transmitted.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint that receives a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame MAY send a single
   packet containing a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame before entering the
   draining state, using a NO_ERROR code if appropriate.  An endpoint
requirements.condition: An endpoint has received a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame but has not yet entered the draining state.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit sending at most one packet, and require that packet to contain a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame if sent.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Sending more than one packet under this pre-draining exception or sending a packet under the exception that does not contain a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can count packets sent between receipt of CONNECTION_CLOSE and entry into draining, and inspect the permitted packet for a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint MAY enter the draining state from the closing state if it
   receives a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame, which indicates that the peer is
   also closing or draining.  In this case, the draining state ends when
requirements.condition: An endpoint in the closing state receives a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Permit a transition from the closing state to the draining state.
requirements.why_checkable: A state-machine test can inject CONNECTION_CLOSE while the endpoint is closing and verify that transition to draining is accepted.

requirements.quote:
also closing or draining.  In this case, the draining state ends when
   the closing state would have ended.  In other words, the endpoint
   uses the same end time but ceases transmission of any packets on this
   connection.
requirements.condition: An endpoint enters the draining state from the closing state after receiving a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.
requirements.required_behavior: End the draining state at the same time the closing state would have ended.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Changing the previously applicable closing-state end time because of the transition to draining.
requirements.why_checkable: A timed state-transition test can record the closing-state end time, trigger the transition to draining, and verify that the end time remains unchanged.

requirements.condition: An endpoint enters the draining state from the closing state.
requirements.required_behavior: Cease transmission of packets on the connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Transmitting any packet on the connection after the transition to draining.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet output can be observed following the closing-to-draining transition to verify that transmission ceases.
